Evanston Investments Dba Evanston Advisors Continues to Hold Holding in A T & T (T); Spectra Energy Partners LP (SEP) Shares Declined While First Heartland Consultants Has Boosted by $682,305 Its Stake
May 17, 2018 - By Maria Brooks
First Heartland Consultants Inc increased its stake in Spectra Energy Partners Lp (SEP) by 84.48% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. First Heartland Consultants Inc bought 17,495 shares as the company’s stock declined 21.17% with the market. The institutional investor held 38,205 shares of the public utilities company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.51M, up from 20,710 at the end of the previous reported quarter. First Heartland Consultants Inc who had been investing in Spectra Energy Partners Lp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $16.40B market cap company. The stock increased 0.85% or $0.28 during the last trading session, reaching $33.38. About 544,376 shares traded. Spectra Energy Partners, LP (NYSE:SEP) has declined 22.60% since May 17, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 34.15% the S&P500.
Evanston Investments Inc Dba Evanston Advisors increased its stake in A T & T Corp (T) by 10.9% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Evanston Investments Inc Dba Evanston Advisors bought 22,623 shares as the company’s stock declined 10.37% with the market. The institutional investor held 230,144 shares of the telecommunications equipment company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $8.95 million, up from 207,521 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Evanston Investments Inc Dba Evanston Advisors who had been investing in A T & T Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $198.14 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.11% or $0.03 during the last trading session, reaching $32.26. About 2.10 million shares traded. AT&T Inc. (NYSE:T) has declined 15.88% since May 17, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 27.43% the S&P500.
First Heartland Consultants Inc, which manages about $867.76 million and $332.38 million US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Coca Cola Company (NYSE:KO) by 7,315 shares to 8,300 shares, valued at $381,000 in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 15,937 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 51,273 shares, and cut its stake in American Express Co (NYSE:AXP).
